title: Buried structural corridors: cover-gated, edge-conditioned, persistence-filtered A-only disagreement
lane: co-training between a geophysical view and a surface view, with disagreement as the discovery signal (Blum & Mitchell, COLT '98, doi:10.1145/279943.279962)

data.qualification: integrity-pinned owner-mirror bytes, SHA-256 verified; NOT organizer-authenticated (DrivenData data tab is login-walled)

protocol.feature_stack: gems52.h57.build_layers default spec cached under work/h62 (16 training_features bands + 9 external bands, val/grad/range = 75 uint8 rank layers); same spec as H60D

views.A: h57.VIEW_A_LAYERS (potential-field/subsurface: gravity 5/11/13/18, magnetics 1/2/3/9/14, strain 4, seismicity 16, depth 15, conductivity 17)
views.B: h57.VIEW_B_LAYERS (surface: radiometric TC 6, det_elev 12, det_elev_slope 19, external LiDAR scarp + GeoDAWN radiometric/ratio bands)

hypotheses.field: max(pA-pB,0) OOF, gated by depth_to_basement>=200m AND potential-field edge grad>=P75 AND line-persistence corridor (line opening 2..4 px half-widths, skeleton length>=15 px, elongation>=3)
hypotheses.layers: View A vs View B OOF probabilities; band 15 depth_to_base; grav_anom_grad/rtp_grad/tmi_hg_grad
hypotheses.physical_signature: multi-km linear density/susceptibility step beneath cover with no DEM/LiDAR scarp
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: labels are surface-mapped (USGS quaternary faults + INGENIOUS); buried faults have no scarp, so they are the canonical faults missing from the catalogue — and the private truth is expert-drawn faults not in the USGS database (official problem page)
hypotheses.new_vs_repo: H60D emitted ungated dis_contrast top-k; H52-1 used cover as population corroboration only; no round filtered a disagreement mask for line persistence or combined cover+edge+persistence on the novel pool
hypotheses.mimic_non_fault: buried paleochannels and basin-fill edges, lithologic contacts, dike swarms

hypotheses.field: H62-1 corridor skeleton crossings (within 2 px) AND (eq_density>=P75 OR geod_2ndinv>=P75)
hypotheses.layers: band 16 eq_density; band 4 geodetic second invariant; H62-1 skeleton
hypotheses.physical_signature: dilational step-overs and fault intersections localize extension, seismicity, hydrothermal upflow (INGENIOUS play-fairway logic)
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: buried intersections have no surface expression at all
hypotheses.new_vs_repo: H53 nodes were azimuth-coincidence tiles; no round extracted crossing nodes of a disagreement corridor skeleton gated on seismicity/strain
hypotheses.mimic_non_fault: induced seismicity clusters, quarry blasts, mining districts

hypotheses.field: H62-1 corridors AND radiometric alteration anomaly (K>=P75 and Th/K<=P25 on ext_geodawn_rad_u8/extensions)
hypotheses.physical_signature: hydrothermal alteration halo of a convective geothermal system along buried structure
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: alteration is not a fault-map criterion; blind systems have no scarp
hypotheses.new_vs_repo: sibling site GEMSDOE46 fused scarp+radiometric on surface features; inside this repo radiometric never gated A-only corridors
hypotheses.mimic_non_fault: ash-flow tuffs with primary K anomalies, lithologic K variation, evaporites

hypotheses.field: 3-round ratcheted co-training (thresholds 0.60/0.70/0.80), whole-segment pseudo-labels, same-seed no-exchange control per round
hypotheses.new_vs_repo: H60D ran exactly one round; no ratcheted multi-round arm exists
hypotheses.mimic_non_fault: self-training drift / confirmation bias (five nulls already measured for one round)

hypotheses.field: View A refit with B-confident/A-abstain population as hard negatives, then A-only disagreement re-ranked
hypotheses.layers: both views; B-only stratum as artifact proxy (roads/quarry/erosion)
hypotheses.physical_signature: de-biasing: remove surface-artifact signature from the geophysical view's confident core
hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: reduces false A-only mass, raising corridor precision
hypotheses.new_vs_repo: no round used the B-only population as labelled hard negatives; external roads vectors (USGS TIGER/Line) would strengthen it but are not required
hypotheses.mimic_non_fault: real faults crossing roads down-weighted as artifacts

decision_rules.independence_gate: abandon co-training framing if block OOF negative-error max|Spearman| >= 0.60
decision_rules.leakage_canary: single-layer holdout AUC > 0.90 flags leakage; stop
decision_rules.weak_surface_subgroup: withheld segments whose mean view-B OOF probability along the segment is below the median across segments; H62-1 must beat view_B there with >=3/4 fold wins (hide instrument, matched budget)
promotion_bar_all_required: 37654px hide pooled H62-1 > ungated dis_contrast AND > matched random
weak_surface_subgroup win vs view_B with >=3/4 folds
format gate 0 problems, all-finite {0,1}, CRS/shape/transform match

uniqueness: no decoded-pattern match; rank-corr <= 0.90 and dot proximity <= 0.70 vs registry rasters excluding manifest-classified calibration rasters (H60-6); raw proximity incl. calibration reported
not-merely-union: >=90% of emitted px outside max(pA,pB) single-view matched-budget emission union
decision_rules.raster_contract: single-band float32 binary {0,1}, all finite (zeros outside footprint — portal rejects NaN with 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]'), EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, sample_submission transform
decision_rules.labelling: every number HOLDOUT-DTI (evaluator version, withheld positives, 95% CI) or OWNER-REPORTED; projections are never scores
decision_rules.budget_of_work: 3 experiments (E1 baselines/canary, E2 H62-1 validation, E3 build+gates) or 2 hours
decision_rules.submission_slot: never spent here; promotion is a separate selector step within the weekly cap
